requirements.text: The system shall ensure that no member can borrow more than 5 books simultaneously, allowing librarian-approved exceptions.
The system shall merge overdue notifications to streamline accountability while maintaining separate digital notifications for sustainability.
The system shall maintain real-time updates on book availability to ensure accurate information for members.
The system shall implement a backup mechanism to recover all transaction data in case of a failure.
The system shall ensure compliance with data protection regulations by implementing encryption for all member data.
The system shall provide an accessible interface for all users, promoting fairness and inclusivity.
The system shall log all transactions, including borrow and return actions, for audit purposes.
The library management system shall minimize energy consumption by using energy-efficient servers and infrastructure.
The system shall provide an energy usage report for library operations at least quarterly.
The library management system shall implement a feedback mechanism for members to report issues or suggestions.
